checks: Ten simultaneous authenticated WebSocket connections and authorized joins
Sustained 20s: 200 socket ACKs and 200 Mongo messages
Authorized Mongo history after sustained load
Auth outage denies send; restored Auth allows send
Tickets outage denies send; restoring Tickets restores permission checks
Mongo outage denies ACK; previous messages survive storage restart
PostgreSQL outage denies send; sessions and tickets survive storage restart
NATS outage leaves transactional outbox pending; consumer catches up on recovery
No phantom ACKs; final Mongo count matches all successful socket sends
limitations: Synthetic fixtures, no production FixIt implementation
Only 10 users and a short load window; local laptop physical cores != AWS vCPU
NATS restart is the same container/volume, not a disaster recovery scenario
Socket middleware only authenticates on connection; writes revalidate via Tickets/Auth
No TLS, CSRF, real backups, multi-node/availability zones, or T3 CPU-credit behavior
